intro: Na Yesuni Prema is the latest Christian Telugu Christmas song written tuned & sung by Srimanth katamala, music by Telugu Christian Gospel Singer, music director, worship leader, Prabhu Pammi and produced by Samuel Varughese. This song was released on April 14, 2021 through Yireh Music YouTube channel.
